name: Mamiya
source:
A mysterious person who appeared in front of Keito when he was younger. He says he's invisible and no one else can recognize him.

It's just a story to Keito, and it doesn't seem to hurt...

[Translated from [url=http://kenkou-land.com/mamiya/#chara]official website[/url]]
